meta.vehicle_source: data.chinausedautohub.com models.json (read-only reference; model_id join key)
meta.principle: relation records store only the delta (facts that exist because THIS vehicle meets THIS market). Every field carries source + source_type + confidence + checked_date; unknown fields are null.
meta.note: duty_anchors and shipping_route REFERENCE taxrules.json/routes.json by id and do not copy rates; pages resolve them at render time. Batch 4 deepens all relation pages with buyer decision points / key risks / practical checklist (derived, source-backed).
